title: Notice Postage Charge Schedule — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
## Notice postage charge — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the notice postage charge enters the retention balance figure. It follows the number of maturity notices sent that the loan's maturity case carries under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product.

| Maturity notices sent recorded on the maturity case | Notice postage charge |
|---|---|
| four or more | USD 35.40 |
| two or three | USD 17.70 |
| one or none | nothing |

Every recorded notice-sent entry on the case is counted, whatever its kind.

*Hypothetical:* a case carrying exactly three notice-sent entries takes USD 17.70; a fourth entry raises the charge to USD 35.40; a case with a single entry carries nothing.
